# Helvety Store

> Catalog pages with product specs, Store-hosted downloads (for example SPFx packages and desktop ZIPs), and install links (for example the Chrome Web Store). Engineered, designed and made in Switzerland.

## Canonical URLs
- [Products catalog](https://helvety.com/store/products): Authoritative product listing (primary landing; nav CTAs use this path)
- [Store zone root](https://helvety.com/store): Redirects to the products catalog

## Product pages
The authoritative catalog is [Products](https://helvety.com/store/products); individual pages include:
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): Jump between SharePoint sites from the header. Favorites and settings stay on your device.
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-pdf): Reorder, merge, rotate, extract, or add images to a PDF in the browser (up to 100 MB per file, 20 open files, 200 pages per file).
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-image-editor): Annotate PNG, JPEG, and WebP in the browser with text, arrows, borders, highlights, blur, and crop (up to 25 MB per image).
- [Helvety OCR](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-ocr): Extract text from PDFs and images in the browser. Scanned pages use on-device OCR in English or German. Born-digital PDFs use their text layer first. Up to 100 MB per file and 50 PDF pages.
- [Helvety Screen Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-screen-tools): Windows screenshots, Live Draw overlay, gallery, and built-in PNG editor. Desktop ZIPs are on GitHub Releases.
- [Helvety Power Platform Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-platform-tools): Portable Windows app for Dataverse in your user context; download the core ZIP (Flow Explorer and Web Resource Explorer included) and optional drop-in module ZIPs from this Store page
- [Power Platform Configurator](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-platform-configurator): Choose classic or new designer for Power Automate flow/run URLs. Control survey flags. Reveal or enable Power Apps form elements. Install from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/power-platform-configurat/mdneakhceachnimmejciaehnfjfabang

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public catalog and product pages are intended to be crawlable and indexable.
- API paths are not crawl or index targets: gateway and store robots disallow `/store/api`.

## Licensing
The helvety.com monorepo is released under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Separately distributed Helvety product repositories may use different open-source licenses, including MIT, so always check the LICENSE file in the specific repository or release source link.
